game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by ember hounds.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by ember hounds. Each round, a new ash bricks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of ash bricks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
